title: On Chewing the dry bread slowly
subtitle: 饮食与营养 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）
meta: 主题语境：饮食与营养（人与自我·生活与学习·饮食与营养）　|　核心词汇：chew　|　正文 343 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 chew 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the clerk ① chewed the dry bread slowly on the same day, and every applicant in the office said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three months on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the clerk ② chews the dry bread slowly before dawn without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ chew the dry bread slowly at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ chewed the dry bread slowly before — a line in the file for May 1977 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Chewing the dry bread slowly on the same day, the clerk said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the stamp at the far counter, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ chew the matter over for a week before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Chew the matter over for a week at once and never mention it again.

By 1990 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the file, and a new applicant from the next office ⑧ chews the matter over for a week on the same day every month without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the counter, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ chewed the dry bread slowly again when nobody else would.

⑩ To chew the dry bread slowly, my mother said in 1995, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the office remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the office forgets, somebody chews the dry bread slowly before dawn again and somebody must chew the dry bread slowly on the same day all over again.

task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 咀嚼（一般过去式 chewed the dry bread slowly：1983 年书记员头一回这样做，当天就）
B. v. 咀嚼（一般现在 chews the dry bread slowly：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 咀嚼（不定式 to chew the dry bread slowly：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 咀嚼（过去完成时 had chewed the dry bread slowly：1977 年五月的卷宗上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 咀嚼（动名词 chewing the dry bread slowly 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 细想（chew the matter over for a week：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去细想把这件事反复想了一周）
G. v. 细想（chew the matter over for a week：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 咀嚼（后段两处：新来的申请人照例 chews the matter over for a week，而母亲又一次 chewed the dry bread slowly）

chew 意为“咀嚼”，结尾那句是母亲 1995 年的话：要咀嚼慢慢嚼那块干面包，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和办事处记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 chew 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1983 the clerk chewed the dry bread slowly on the same day, and nobody in the office forgot it.
Even now the clerk chews the dry bread slowly before dawn whenever the office asks.
Chewing the dry bread slowly on the same day, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever chew the matter over for a week before dawn, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new applicant from the next office chews the matter over for a week on the same day every month, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother chewed the dry bread slowly again, and the office remembered that half.
